score: infinity if unsafe anywhere; otherwise max |physical lateral error| from 2.0 through 8.0 seconds
claim: For a prespecified frozen controller and exchangeable complete trajectories, P(finite_radius AND (unsafe OR tail_error > calibrated_radius)) <= alpha, marginal over calibration and new trajectory. Infinite radius is uninformative. This is NOT conditional 95 percent coverage given a particular radius, finite-radius selection or certificate acceptance.
distinction: statistical performance bound; not an all-disturbance reachability or precision certificate
